messages:
Leah (Support): quick heads-up — customer Acme GmbH needs invoices with full legal entity fields (company name, registered address, VAT/Tax ID), PO# on header, and itemized lines for each model/usage. They said the PDF we sent shows 'Redwood' only and a single 'usage' line. They need the company name, address, VAT for EU reclaim.

Dina (Billing): can you paste the customer's exact format? Our invoice templates support these fields: billing_entity_name, billing_address_line1, billing_address_line2, billing_city, billing_country, tax_id, po_number, line_items[]. Also there are two templates: "standard" and "simplified" for small spenders — which one did they get?

Leah (Support): Repro steps:
```
# 1) POST /v1/invoices (authenticated)
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoices" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"customer_id":"cus_123","billing":{"entity":{"name":"Acme GmbH","address":{"line1":"Musterstrasse 1","city":"Berlin","country":"DE"},"tax_id":"DE123456789"},"po_number":"PO-98765"},"line_items":[{"desc":"embedding tokens","qty":1000,"unit_price":0.0005}],"template":"standard"}'
```
Actual: PDF received missing "billing_entity_name" and "tax_id" fields and line_items collapsed into single aggregated row.

billing-bot: invoice-generation job failed for customer_id=cus_123 (job 98765): TemplateMissingField: 'billing_entity_name' not present in payload. Retrying.

Tomas (Eng): I can repro locally. Root cause: template renderer is only checking for top-level keys (billing_entity_name, billing_address, tax_id) but our API accepts nested billing.entity.*. Renderer doesn't traverse nested objects.

Proposed quick fix: add a mapping layer that normalizes incoming payloads to fully flattened keys before rendering. Patch will accept either top-level billing_entity_name or billing.entity.name and similarly for address/tax. ETA: 48h for PR + canary.

Temp workaround (do this now): include flattened fields at top-level in your request body. Example payload to send now:
```
{
  "customer_id":"cus_123",
  "billing_entity_name":"Acme GmbH",
  "billing_address_line1":"Musterstrasse 1",
  "billing_city":"Berlin",
  "billing_country":"DE",
  "tax_id":"DE123456789",
  "po_number":"PO-98765",
  "line_items":[{"desc":"embedding tokens","qty":1000,"unit_price":0.0005}],
  "template":"standard"
}
```

Sam (Account Exec): Customer is asking for a signed PDF and gross/net line item breakdown. This is blocking the PO signing — can we prioritize? :worried: 

Dina (Billing): I'll escalate to priority-high for this customer. Leah, I'll send the workaround and offer to re-issue corrected PDF once eng patch is live. Also adding VAT/tax fields to the public invoice schema doc.

Leah (Support): thanks all :thumbsup: please @Tomas tag me in the PR and I'll notify the customer when canary is live.
